name: relai-browser
description: Needs Claude Code with mods (measured on 2.1.325). RelAI Browser: pictures that tools hand to Claude (browser screenshots, Read of an image, MCP images) are shrunk before Claude reads them, so they cost fewer tokens — half the longer side by default, never under 512 px; JPEG stays JPEG (quality 85), the rest becomes PNG; screenshot coordinates are rewritten so clicks still land. Mode describe sends each picture to a helper model (claude-haiku-5-5 by default) and gives Claude a description in words; a description that runs past the 10 s hook budget lets the picture through unchanged. Windows (PowerShell + System.Drawing) and macOS (sips); elsewhere pictures pass unchanged. Asks once per RelAI project (row 'Mody oszczędzania' in docs/USTAWIENIA.md) and stays passive in a session with no person before that answer. Sleeps while the BenAI 'efficient-browser-use' mod is on. /relai-browser full lets the next picture through whole; shrink, describe, scale, min and pane set the mode and defaults or open the list. Every shrink and description goes to the RelAI savings ledger (~/.claude/relai/oszczednosci/rejestr/). No model call outside describe, no network.
